memory_records.path_id: Unique ID for this analysis path. For example, Bruner_ExpEco_2017_amYY_path01
memory_records.case_id: ID of the paper or case.
memory_records.path_summary: Short summary of the analysis path.

controls: List of control variables, or empty list.
path_signature.sample_restriction: Sample inclusion or exclusion rule, or null.
path_signature.missing_data_rule: Missing data handling rule, or null.
path_signature.variable_construction: explains how the main variables are created or changed before analysis, or null. For example, Create risk_aversion_score by averaging safe choices across PV and RV tasks, then standardize the score before regression.
path_signature.inference_rule: explains how the result will be judged. For example, Support the claim if the coefficient for risk_aversion_score is negative and p < 0.05.

memory_records.status_reason: Short reason explaining why this status was assigned.
